title: Business Portfolio Schema
description: Tracks the investment portfolio and treasury allocation for a Business Capsule.

portfolioId.description: Unique identifier for the investment portfolio.

totalValueUsd.description: Total estimated value of all assets in USD.

platformContributionRate.description: Percentage (0.0 to 1.0) of revenue automatically routed to the global UniversalDistributionPool.

lastRebalanceTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp of the last portfolio rebalance.
